title: Return-Reason Relief on Northgate Cash Reversals
content:
**Return reasons.** Under the consumer return reversal schedule of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships, the reason recorded on the return adds to the relief fraction of the reversal. The reason is the return reason on the return record on Northgate Store and Online Orders.

| Return reason | Added to the relief fraction |
|---|---|
| wrong item | 0.2 (20 percent) |
| damaged in transit | 0.2 (20 percent) |
| defective | 0.1 (10 percent) |
| not as described | 0.1 (10 percent) |
| any other reason | nothing |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A return recorded as damaged in transit adds 0.2 to the relief fraction; the same return recorded as no longer needed adds nothing.
